participant_id.Description: Unique participant identifier, formatted as sub-XXX where XXX is the zero-padded subject number from the raw data files.

age.Description: Age in years, obtained from the demographics questionnaire.

sex.Description: Self-reported gender, mapped to BIDS convention: M = Male, F = Female, D = Diverse / other.

n_sessions.Description: Number of sessions completed by the participant (1 or 2).

session_interval_days.Description: Number of days between the ses-01 and ses-02 acquisition dates, parsed from raw filenames. n/a for participants with only one session.

analysis_excluded.Description: Whether the participant was excluded from the published analysis (1 = excluded, 0 = included).

exclusion_reason.Description: Reason for exclusion from the published analysis. n/a = included (not excluded).

Levels.no_second_session: Participant only completed ses-01, no ses-02 data available
Levels.low_go_accuracy_ses01: Participant had low go-trial accuracy in session 1; hard-coded as subject_id != 25 in R analysis scripts
